text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin is in poor shape, and she drags her feet as she exits the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once the gates open, there's nothing more I can do to help her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All I can do is pray that Narita Taishin returns in one piece.
